note: Roadmap to the Platinum, built from the official trophy descriptions. Order: story first with chapter saves, then the duo, side stories, robberies, races and stunts, collectibles, and finally the 100% cleanup.

stages.goal: Finish the story — and save like it matters
notes: No mission replay and no New Game Plus: once a story mission is done you cannot select it again.
Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends — it is the only missable trophy (see Positive Mental Attitude).
The Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, race the moment it appears.
Never use cheats on your trophy save: cheats should switch off both trophies and saving.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story

stages.goal: Unlock Jason + Lucia as a duo and start the partner trophies
notes: Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Meditate at outdoor spots with your partner — each outdoor spot counts twice, once per character.
Train at the gym with your partner so both reach maximum Strength together.
Bank vault jobs later hand you a 4-star Wanted Level — escape one with your partner for Hot Together.
stages.title: 2 · Unlock the duo

stages.goal: Finish the side stories and the stranger strands
notes: Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends, so these can wait — but finish each strand to its final mission; only the finale pops its trophy.
Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks (they have their own trophies). Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand.
Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
stages.title: 3 · Side stories & strangers

stages.goal: Rob Leonida: jewelry, vaults, trucks and gangs
notes: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies.
Bank vaults open near the end of Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs; the 100% checklist wants all 39.
Robbery trophies only pop once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
stages.title: 4 · Rob Leonida

stages.goal: Races, stunts, shooting and the arcade
notes: 250 stunts for the trophy, 300 for 100% — keep going past the pop.
42 Shooting Range gold medals across two ranges; 14 Top Fun drone race locations, one win each.
Win 20 different races — variety counts, repeats do not.
Any of the four arcade games counts for Stick Fiddler; beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
stages.title: 5 · Races, stunts & range time

stages.goal: Collect the state: meditate, scan, buy and register
notes: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; bring your partner to outdoor spots.
Scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app counts as discovering them — scan traffic as you drive.
Buy all 8 garages first (about $160,000): each registered car needs a free garage space.
Explore all 52 areas; the last few corners are easiest to sweep once the story is done.
stages.title: 6 · Collect the state

stages.goal: Clean up to 100% and take the Platinum
notes: The 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but work done earlier still counts.
Biggest remaining items: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations.
When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows immediately. Around 200 hours all in — long, not hard.
stages.title: 7 · The long road to 100%
